content.title: Incorrect discount calculation in `discounted_total` function
acceptance: The test `test_percentage_discount_is_applied_to_subtotal` at line 8 fails with `AssertionError: 19990 != 18000`.
The function `discounted_total` in `invoice.py` (line 10) computes `subtotal_cents - discount_percent`, which for inputs (20000, 10) yields 19990.
The correct behavior should subtract the discount amount (10% of 20000 = 2000), resulting in 18000.
The current implementation incorrectly treats the discount percentage as a direct subtraction rather than calculating the discount amount first.
